facts.value: Reads Fighter.allow_interrupt; when true passes gobj through ftCo_80095328(gobj, false), ftCo_800D7100, ftCo_800C3B10, local checkItemThrowInput, ftCo_800D705C and ftCo_800CB870 in order. The first true result stops processing. Accepted immediate pickup may acquire an item rather than immediately change motion. The later ftCo_800D705C call cannot set its timer here: reaching it means the preceding local attack check returned false with no new A press, but the timer predicate requires that press. The first call passes a NULL optional bool output pointer, not a false policy flag.
facts.rationale: Correct stick-source exclusivity, accepted-handler semantics, consumed facing flag, landing scope or object-specific storage.

evidence.why: Canonical implementation and signature.

facts.value: Accepts newly pressed A or a new C-stick axis threshold crossing. Reads the selector result, which can use either stick, and held-item state. For selected neutral/forward aerial and item category 3, dispatches ftCo_800CDDA0; otherwise dispatches decideFighter. Returns true after dispatch, false when the input gate fails; true does not itself guarantee a changed motion.

facts.value: No accepted attack request returns false. An accepted request dispatches exactly one callee: ftCo_800CDDA0 for category-3 item plus neutral/forward selection, otherwise decideFighter, and then returns true. The item-use callee has a default no-op branch, so this is accepted dispatch rather than an unconditional transition guarantee.
